name: The Decontexualization of Asian Religious Practices in the Context of Globalization
headline: The Decontexualization of Asian Religious Practices in the Context of Globalization
description: The article focuses on analysis of decontexulization approaches for religious practices associated with Asia under globalization conditions; and assessment of yoga techniques along with other conditions such as meditation involvement in religious practices.
